title: Diversifying time evolution of matrix product states using BUGs
summary: Time evolution of tensor-network states is a central tool for studying nonequilibrium dynamics in strongly correlated quantum systems. In the past decade, using the time-dependent variational principle (TDVP) discretized by projector-splitting has become the gold standard for evolving matrix product states (MPS) with long-range Hamiltonians.
